'''Gauther''' was the third and outermost [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Binary star/Legends|binary stars]] [[Desev]] and [[Maugina]] in the [[Desev system]],<ref name="GW" /> located in the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]],<ref name="Xim" /> situated within [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="The Slice" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="GW" /><ref name="EAOC" /> Gauther was an [[Water/Legends|ice]] ball without any [[Moon/Legends|moons]].<ref name="GW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The worlds in the [[Desev system]], except [[Desevro/Legends|Desevro]], were designed for the [[2004]] sourcebook ''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GW" /> Later, the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], placed the Desev star system in grid square S-6.<ref name="EAOC" />
